packing_proof.scope: Exhaustive finite coefficient packing identity; no GPU/codegen/performance claim.
packing_proof.reasoning: Unsigned multiplication has no low-half carry because each product is at most1333. Packed negation has no low-half carry because every magnitude is nonzero.
